"""분리 API와 내부 HTTP 클라이언트에서 원본 영상의 일반·단어 정렬 경로를 비교한다."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from time import monotonic,sleep

ROOT=Path('/Users/macbookair/Desktop/K-aption_BE')
DIRECTORY=Path('/private/tmp/kaption-word-api-internal-261026')
DIRECTORY.mkdir()
for filename,source in (('server.py','/private/tmp/kaption-word-api-server-261026.py'),('client.py','/private/tmp/kaption-word-api-client-261026.py')):
    (DIRECTORY/filename).write_text(Path(source).read_text())
report={'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'server_source':(DIRECTORY/'server.py').read_text(),
        'client_source':(DIRECTORY/'client.py').read_text(),'runs':[],
        'limits':['Original 212.5866875-second video; CPU4 backend, CPU8 translator.',
                  'HTTP client container uses the same internal network; not host port upload.',
                  'Backend STT starts unloaded; translator uses identical cache-disabled warmup.',
                  'Candidate includes small alignment audit file writes.',
                  'Windows amd64 and host total RAM are untested.']}
order=['baseline','candidate']
for index,mode in enumerate(order):
    label=f'run{index+1}-{mode}'
    destination=DIRECTORY/label
    destination.mkdir()
    name='kaption-word-api-eval'
    command=['docker','run','-d','--name',name,'--network','k-aption_be_inference',
             '--cpus','4','--memory','2500000000','--memory-swap','2500000000',
             '-e','PYTHONPATH=/app','-e','HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1','-e','HF_HUB_DISABLE_IMPLICIT_TOKEN=1',
             '-e','KAPTION_TRANSLATOR_URL=http://translator:8080','-e','KAPTION_TRANSLATOR_PROMPT_CACHE=true',
             '-e',f'KAPTION_JOB_DIR=/reports/{label}/jobs','-e','KAPTION_MAX_ACTIVE_JOBS=2',
             '-e','OMP_NUM_THREADS=4','-e','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1','-e','MKL_NUM_THREADS=1',
             '--mount',f'type=bind,source={ROOT},target=/app,readonly',
             '--mount',f'type=bind,source={DIRECTORY},target=/reports',
             '--mount','type=volume,source=k-aption_be_whisper-cache,target=/cache/huggingface,readonly',
             '--entrypoint','python','kaption-backend:local','/reports/server.py',
             '--mode',mode,'--reports',f'/reports/{label}']
    print('Starting',label,flush=True)
    subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True)
    try:
        deadline=monotonic()+30
        ready="import json,urllib.request; assert json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/health',timeout=2))['translation_model_loaded']"
        while monotonic()<deadline:
            result=subprocess.run(['docker','exec',name,'python','-c',ready],capture_output=True)
            if result.returncode==0:break
            sleep(.5)
        else:raise RuntimeError('API not ready internally')
        warmup="from app.main import create_translation_service; s=create_translation_service(); s.cache_prompt=False; print(s.translate('This is the initial mass.','',128)['translation']); s.close()"
        subprocess.run(['docker','exec',name,'python','-c',warmup],capture_output=True,check=True)
        command=['docker','run','--rm','--name','kaption-word-http-client',
                 '--network','k-aption_be_inference','--cpus','1','--memory','268435456',
                 '--memory-swap','268435456','--mount',f'type=bind,source={ROOT},target=/app,readonly',
                 '--mount',f'type=bind,source={DIRECTORY},target=/reports',
                 '--entrypoint','python','kaption-backend:local','/reports/client.py',
                 '--output',f'/reports/{label}/http.json']
        result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
        row={'label':label,'mode':mode,**json.loads((destination/'http.json').read_text())}
        row['client_log']={'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr}
        row['logs']=subprocess.check_output(['docker','logs',name],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
        fmt=('{"image":{{json .Image}},"cpu":{{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}},"memory":{{.HostConfig.Memory}},'
             '"memory_swap":{{.HostConfig.MemorySwap}},"oom":{{.State.OOMKilled}},"restarts":{{.RestartCount}}}')
        row['state']=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker','inspect',name,'--format',fmt],text=True))
        row['memory_observation']=subprocess.check_output(['docker','exec',name,'sh','-c','cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events'],text=True)
        row['failed']=sum(s['translation_error'] is not None for s in row['result'].get('segments',[]))
        row['alignment_audits']=[json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted(destination.glob('aligned-source-*.json'))]
        report['runs'].append(row)
        (DIRECTORY/'comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
        print(json.dumps({'label':label,'seconds':row['seconds'],'status':row['status'],'segments':len(row['result'].get('segments',[])),'failed':row['failed']}),flush=True)
        if mode=='candidate' and index==1:
            baseline=report['runs'][0]
            if row['status']==200 and not row['failed'] and row['seconds']<baseline['seconds']*.9:
                order.extend(['candidate','baseline'])
    finally:
        logs=subprocess.run(['docker','logs',name],capture_output=True,text=True)
        (destination/'server.log').write_text(logs.stdout+logs.stderr)
        subprocess.run(['docker','stop','--timeout','5',name],capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(['docker','rm',name],capture_output=True,check=True)

"""기존 API에 평가용 단어 정렬 STT만 주입하고 운영 컨테이너와 분리해 실행한다."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from uuid import uuid4

from faster_whisper import BatchedInferencePipeline
from transcribe import TranscriptionService
from app.services.stt_words import split_aligned_segments
from scripts.evaluate_cpu_stt_options import save_new
import app.main as api

REPORTS = None


class AlignedModel:
    """동일 Whisper 모델의 배치 단어 정렬을 기존 STT 구간 인터페이스로 감싼다."""

    def __init__(self, model):
        """로드된 CPU 모델을 재사용하는 배치 전사기를 생성한다.

        :param model: 메모리 제한 특징 추출기를 가진 기존 WhisperModel.
        :return: None.
        """
        self.pipeline = BatchedInferencePipeline(model=model)

    def transcribe(self, audio, **options):
        """단어 정렬 원문을 기록하고 검증한 자막 조각을 기존 호출자에게 반환한다.

        :param audio: 16kHz 단일 채널 오디오 배열.
        :param options: 기존 STT의 language·task·beam_size·VAD·힌트 설정.
        :return: start·end·text 객체 생성기와 기존 언어 정보의 튜플.
        :raises ValueError: 정렬 시각 또는 원문 보존 검사가 실패한 경우.

        평가 전용 REPORTS 경로에 원시 단어와 분할 결과를 새 JSON으로 저장한다.
        """
        segments, info = self.pipeline.transcribe(audio, **options, batch_size=2,
                                                 without_timestamps=True, word_timestamps=True)
        raw = [{'start': s.start, 'end': s.end, 'text': s.text,
                'words': [{'start': w.start, 'end': w.end, 'word': w.word,
                           'probability': w.probability} for w in (s.words or [])]}
               for s in segments if s.text.strip()]
        cues = split_aligned_segments(raw, len(audio) / 16000)
        save_new(REPORTS / ('aligned-source-' + uuid4().hex + '.json'),
                 {'raw': raw, 'cues': cues, 'audio_seconds': len(audio) / 16000})
        return (SimpleNamespace(**cue) for cue in cues), info


class EvaluationTranscriber(TranscriptionService):
    """기존 업로드·길이·음성 검증과 공유 잠금을 유지하며 평가 모델만 대체한다."""

    def _get_model(self):
        """기존 지연 로드 모델과 단어 정렬 어댑터를 한 번 만들고 재사용한다.

        :return: 기존 transcribe 인터페이스를 제공하는 평가용 어댑터.
        """
        model = super()._get_model()
        if not hasattr(self, '_aligned_proxy'):
            self._aligned_proxy = AlignedModel(model)
        return self._aligned_proxy


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--mode', choices=('baseline', 'candidate'), required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--reports', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    REPORTS = args.reports
    if args.mode == 'candidate':
        api.TranscriptionService = EvaluationTranscriber
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(api.app, host='0.0.0.0', port=8000)

"""내부 네트워크의 평가 API에 원본 영상을 업로드하고 실제 HTTP 시간을 저장한다."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter
import httpx

if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    media=Path('/app/MIT8_01F16_W06PS01-2_360p.mp4')
    with httpx.Client(base_url='http://kaption-word-api-eval:8000',timeout=180,trust_env=False) as client:
        initial=client.get('/health').json()
        started=perf_counter()
        with media.open('rb') as stream:
            response=client.post('/api/v1/transcriptions',params={'language':'en'},files={'file':(media.name,stream,'video/mp4')})
        report={'seconds':perf_counter()-started,'initial_health':initial,
                'status':response.status_code,'request_id':response.headers.get('x-request-id'),
                'result':response.json(),'media_sha256':hashlib.sha256(media.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                'final_health':client.get('/health').json()}
    with args.output.open('x') as target:json.dump(report,target,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    print(json.dumps({'seconds':report['seconds'],'status':report['status']}),flush=True)

segments.text: The tricky bit is that we need to take care of the integration limits here.

"""정렬된 STT 단어의 원문·순서를 보존하면서 시각과 문장 경계로 자막 조각을 구성한다."""

import math
from numbers import Real

from app.services.subtitles import SENTENCE_END


def _cue(words: list, max_duration: float, max_chars: int) -> dict:
    """연속 단어의 실제 시각과 원문으로 상한 안의 자막 조각 하나를 만든다.

    :param words: start·end·word를 가진 비어 있지 않은 순서 보존 단어 목록.
    :param max_duration: 조각의 최대 시간(초).
    :param max_chars: 조각 원문의 최대 문자 수.
    :return: start·end·text 사전. 시각이나 문장부호를 추론하지 않는다.
    :raises ValueError: 시각이 없거나 나눌 수 없는 단어 묶음이 상한을 넘는 경우.
    """
    result = {'start': words[0]['start'], 'end': max(w['end'] for w in words),
              'text': ''.join(w['word'] for w in words).strip()}
    if (result['end'] <= result['start']
            or result['end'] - result['start'] > max_duration + 1e-6
            or len(result['text']) > max_chars):
        raise ValueError('Aligned words cannot form a bounded subtitle cue')
    return result


def split_aligned_segments(segments: list, duration: float, max_duration: float = 18,
                           max_chars: int = 350, max_gap: float = 2) -> list:
    """검증한 단어를 문장·무음·상한 경계에서 나누고 전체 원문 보존을 확인한다.

    :param segments: text와 words(start·end·word)를 가진 순서 보존 STT 원시 구간 목록.
    :param duration: 실제 음성 길이(초). 양의 유한값이어야 한다.
    :param max_duration: 자막 조각 최대 시간(초). 기본 18초, 양의 유한값.
    :param max_chars: 자막 조각 최대 원문 문자 수. 기본 350, 양의 정수.
    :param max_gap: 조각을 나누는 무음 상한(초). 기본 2초, 0 이상 유한값.
    :return: 단어 순서·내용을 보존하고 음성 범위 안에서 겹치지 않는 start·end·text 목록.
    :raises ValueError: 단어 누락·원문 불일치·비유한/역행/범위 밖 시각·분할 불가능 상한인 경우.

    단어 사이 공백 외에 원문을 고치거나 삭제하지 않으며, 영시간 단어는 양의 길이
    조각에 포함한다. 겹치는 단어 사이와 붙어 있는 토큰 안에서는 조각을 나누지 않는다.
    입력 사전·단어 목록을 수정하거나 누락된 시각을 새로 만들지 않는다.
    """
    if (any(not isinstance(value, Real) or isinstance(value, bool)
            for value in (duration, max_duration, max_gap))
            or not math.isfinite(duration) or duration <= 0
            or not math.isfinite(max_duration) or max_duration <= 0
            or type(max_chars) is not int or max_chars <= 0
            or not math.isfinite(max_gap) or max_gap < 0):
        raise ValueError('Invalid aligned subtitle limits')
    words, sources = [], []
    for segment in segments:
        if not isinstance(segment, dict) or not isinstance(segment.get('text'), str):
            raise ValueError('Invalid aligned source segment')
        text = segment['text'].strip()
        if not text:
            continue
        aligned = segment.get('words')
        if (not isinstance(aligned, (list, tuple)) or not aligned
                or any(not isinstance(w, dict) or not {'start', 'end', 'word'} <= w.keys()
                       or not isinstance(w['word'], str) for w in aligned)):
            raise ValueError('Missing or malformed aligned words')
        if ' '.join(''.join(w['word'] for w in aligned).split()) != ' '.join(text.split()):
            raise ValueError('Aligned words do not preserve the source text')
        sources.append(text)
        for index, original in enumerate(aligned):
            start, end, piece = original['start'], original['end'], original['word']
            if (not piece.strip()
                    or any(not isinstance(value, Real) or isinstance(value, bool)
                           for value in (start, end))
                    or not math.isfinite(start) or not math.isfinite(end)
                    or not 0 <= start <= end <= duration
                    or (words and start < words[-1]['start'])):
                raise ValueError('Invalid or unordered aligned word timestamps')
            if words and index == 0 and not piece[0].isspace():
                piece = ' ' + piece
            words.append({'start': start, 'end': end, 'word': piece})
    cues, pending = [], []
    for index, word in enumerate(words):
        if pending:
            end = max(w['end'] for w in pending)
            text = ''.join(w['word'] for w in pending).strip()
            safe = word['start'] >= end and word['word'][0].isspace() and end > pending[0]['start']
            if safe and (word['end'] - pending[0]['start'] > max_duration
                         or len(text + word['word']) > max_chars
                         or word['start'] - end > max_gap):
                cues.append(_cue(pending, max_duration, max_chars))
                pending = []
        pending.append(word)
        next_word = words[index + 1] if index + 1 < len(words) else None
        end = max(w['end'] for w in pending)
        safe_end = (next_word is None or (next_word['start'] >= end
                    and next_word['word'][0].isspace()))
        if safe_end and end > pending[0]['start'] and SENTENCE_END.search(word['word'].strip()):
            cues.append(_cue(pending, max_duration, max_chars))
            pending = []
    if pending:
        cues.append(_cue(pending, max_duration, max_chars))
    if ' '.join(' '.join(c['text'] for c in cues).split()) != ' '.join(' '.join(sources).split()):
        raise ValueError('Subtitle segmentation changed the source text')
    return cues
